<ic>Resupply the Seventh Wave with 42 wains<br>Resupply the Wolves of War with 43 wains<br>Resupply the Winter Sun with 43 wains<br>Resupply the Army of the Citadel with 42 wains<br><br>''Approved by the Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies.''</ic>

===Overview===
* Resupply the [[Highguard|Highborn]] army of the [[Highguard_military_concerns#The_Seventh_Wave|Seventh Wave]].
* Resupply the [[The League|League]] army of the [[The_League_military_concerns#The_Wolves_of_War|Wolves of War]].
* Resupply the [[Imperial Orcs|Imperial orc]] army of the [[Imperial_Orcs_territories#The_Winter_Sun|Winter Sun]].
* Resupply the [[Urizen]] army of the [[Citadel Guard]].

The actions are grouped together, but each would count as a separate announcement for purposes of the [[Synod]] [[veto]].

===Date===
* Spring Equinox 378YE

===Progress===
* 170 wains of Mithril and Weirwood provided by Janusz Dalibor von Temeschwar, Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies, after Spring Equinox 378YE
** 42 wains for the Seventh Wave
** 43 wains for the Wolves of War
** 43 wains for the Winter Sun
** 42 wains for the Citadel Guard

===Campaign Outcome===
* [[Casualties#Emergency_Resupply|Resupply]] an army using 42 wains restores fighting strength equal to 840 soldiers to the army.
* Resupply an army using 43 wains restored fighting strength equal to 860 soldiers to the army.

===Voting===
This motion was approved by the Quartermaster General using the legal power to resupply armies granted by the [[Senate]].
